name: graft
description: Persistent local memory for coding agents: recall past fixes, decisions and gotchas before solving them again, and save what was learned.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent local memory for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Graft keeps the fixes, decisions and gotchas your agent works out, in a local graph on your machine, and brings them back when a similar problem shows up. No account, no API key, no cloud. Run /graft-init once to install graft and wire it in.
